answer.justification: b, s and the third listed object

distractors: counting Y itself as part of its own conditioning set
prose: An outcome Y depends on a coefficient vector b, a noise scale s, and a covariate matrix X. The law of Y is stated conditionally on all three of those, and on nothing else.
question: How many distinct symbols appear in the conditioning set of the law of Y? Give a single number.
reference_hml:
module ConditioningSet

rv Y : RandomVariable[Real]
param b : Real
param s : PositiveReal
obs c : Real = 0

law Y | b s c ~ Normal(location := b, scale := s)
